standard_prerequisites.use: Formally etale morphisms, the decomposition of etaleness into flat, unramified and locally finitely presented, and the algebra characterisation of formally etale ring maps; the converse is retained.

core_obligations: Derive local finite presentation and formal etaleness from etaleness using flatness, unramifiedness and the earlier characterisation.
Prove the converse by reducing the scheme statement to the algebra statement for formally etale ring maps.

proof_roadmap.step: Show that an etale morphism is locally of finite presentation and formally etale.
Reduce the converse to the corresponding algebra statement for ring maps.
Conclude etaleness from the algebra result.

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence between etaleness and the pair of conditions locally of finite presentation plus formally etale. One direction decomposes etaleness into flatness, unramifiedness and local finite presentation and feeds these into the earlier characterisation; the other direction is the substantive implication, where formal etaleness plus local finite presentation must be converted into etaleness by a reduction to the algebra statement about formally etale ring maps. The reduction to the algebra statement is what the converse turns on. Retained author proof at lines 1716-1742.
